newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch.

text.p: * Intel Corp shares were down 1/2 at 153-3/8 in London following a published report that Compaq Computer Corp will announce Thursday a personal computer priced at less than $1,000. Compaq closed at 85-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange Wednesday.

* News of the death of Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping's had only a minor impact on selected stocks in London overnight. Boeing Co, which historically has captured two-thirds of the Chinese market for commercial jets, was down 3/8 at 109-3/8.
Exxon Corp, which has a significant presence in the Chinese energy sector, was down 1/2 at 102-5/8.
* AMR Corp stood at 82-1/4 in after-hours trading Wednesday, even with its close, despite a late report that Gruntal & Co had cut its 1997 earnings estimates for the company.
* American International Group Inc is expected to report fourth quarter earnings per share of $1.58, up from $1.40 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 125-5/8.
* Cox Communications Inc is expected to report a fourth quarter loss of $0.10 per share, compared with a profit of $0.41 a year ago, according to First Call. The stock closed at 23-1/4.
